active_invariant.name: Nothing Dies
scope: protection of human life and safe-state behavior
non-destructive preservation of research sources and provenance
knowledge and memory do not grant permission to execute
active_invariant.interpretation: Safety objective and governance policy, not absolute guarantee of zero casualties or indefinite retention of personal information
active_invariant.privacy: Consent, privacy, and valid data deletion requests take precedence over indefinite retention; preserve lawful non-personal audit receipts
